subtask: Walk forward along the path, bearing slightly to the right.
end_condition: the round stone basin with the bamboo spout is visible ahead (it may still be small and far)

subtask: Keep moving toward the round stone basin with the bamboo spout.
start_condition: the round stone basin with the bamboo spout is visible ahead (it may still be small and far)
end_condition: the round stone basin with the bamboo spout is the largest object in view and its details are clearly visible

subtask: Stop when the round stone basin with the bamboo spout is directly in front of you and fills the centre of the camera view.
start_condition: the round stone basin with the bamboo spout is the largest object in view and its details are clearly visible
end_condition: the round stone basin with the bamboo spout is directly in front of the robot and fills the centre of the camera view
